crossRefs.note: Now, behold, I go bound by the Spirit to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there;
except that the Holy Spirit testifies in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions wait for me.
Coming to us and taking Paul’s belt, he bound his own feet and hands, and said, “The Holy Spirit says: ‘So the Jews at…
Woe to you who destroy, but you weren’t destroyed, and who betray, but nobody betrayed you! When you have finished…
“Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents, and cause…
Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’ If they persecuted me, they will also…
“I have said these things to you so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.
For, I think that God has displayed us, the apostles, last of all, like men sentenced to death. For we are made a…
Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more…
For this cause I also suffer these things. Yet I am not ashamed, for I know him whom I have believed, and I am…
in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.
Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones’ sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ…
persecutions, and sufferings: those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those…
Here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name.”
“Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
Then they will deliver you up to oppression, and will kill you. You will be hated by all of the nations for my name’s…
If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed; because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you. On…
I John, your brother and partner with you in the oppression, Kingdom, and perseverance in Christ Jesus, was on the isle…
